person_note: The base narration is the much longer World War II story, sustained in third person around Vianne and Isabelle. A first-person 1995 frame appears at the opening and returns at the conclusion, but under the base-narration rule a brief bookending frame does not make the novel ALTERNATING. Authorized excerpts establish both the third-person core and the first-person frame, while whole-book structural sources confirm their unequal roles. Isolated wartime first-person speech is dialogue rather than an additional narrative strand.
